interest: Shows WWII intercepts of Japanese commercial radio traffic, and early Allied planning on postwar Japan's economy.
overview: Docket (1943-44) on Japan's economy: Chungking despatches forwarding intercepted Japanese commercial radio traffic, plus reports on war economy, Sansom talks on postwar Japan, Dutch Indies oil demolitions, and Japan's 1944 national income.
